title: Client Firewall
tagline: Keep one client's information out of another client's work in Claude.
problem: If you work inside several companies at once, one rushed paste into Claude can put Client B's numbers into Client A's deliverable.
steps: In claude.ai, create one Project per client.
Paste the Client Firewall instructions into the Project's instructions.
Fill in a rules file for that client and add it to the Project's knowledge.

colors.rule: Nothing risky. Claude drafts as normal.
Sensitive details the task doesn't need. Claude offers a cleaned-up version first.
Another client's details or a never-share item. Claude stops and tells you what to remove.

limits: It only knows the clients you list in the rules file, plus obviously sensitive data.
It's a second check, not a guarantee. The model can be wrong.
You still decide what gets sent.
